segments.text: Now in the next sutra, the author explains how by the immense of this paramarsha,
immense you, you understand?
Intensity, intensity of paramarsha, intensity of meditation.
Then what happens?
Vithana-vapi-yeprasyanda-beda-va-sambhavati.
This vithana, this external state of active consciousness.
No, dualistic consciousness is absorbed in non- dualistic consciousness.
Vithana-vapi-yeprasyanda-beda-va-sambhavati.
This is explained in this sixth sutra.
Vithana-vapi-yeprasyanda-beda-va-sambhavati.
Then he establishes and meditates on the will of energies of Lord Shiva.
Vithana-vapi-yeprasyanda-beda-va-sambhavati.
The whole external universe of dualistic state takes an end.
It ends for good.
Jyoyam parapratiba unma janaatma uddandrata sabhago bairava uktaha.
Aiseva, antarlaksi bairdraśtiyatma taya, nişeji shakti chakra krama akrama kramini,
aatekranhta krama akrama aterikta arikta tat ubiyatma taya api abhidei manapi,
anetadrupa anutara para saatandraśakti kaapi asti.
Bairava, which is already explained, that it takes you to the highest summit of uddandrata,
active consciousness.
And that bairava is found together with saatandraśakti.
The saatandraśakti, he defines now, is antarlaksi bairdraśtiyatma taya.
How the saatandraśakti is found in one with bairava, antarlaksi bairdraśtiyatma taya.
Keeping organs in action and observing that action within.
You have to keep your organs in action.
And in that state, you have to establish yourself inside.
It is bairavumantra.
Nishayasiśakti chakra krama akrama kramini.
That supreme energy of bairava stands forth who has held akramini.
Who has held Nishayasiśakti chakra, krama akrama.
The success you weigh and non-success you weigh of totality of energies.
All collective energies.
The success you, movement of all energies and non-success you, movement of all energies is held by that supreme state of...
Who is non-successive movement of energy?
Non-successive, akrama.
And there is no succession. There is only one flight.
Only point and point.
Not journey, not space.
Is it some practice and we go on to practice?
Yes, we have to practice.
So krama will be...
Krama will be shaktopaya and onopaya.
Akrama will be shambopaya.
And shambopaya is also digested in that saatandrśakti and shaktopaya and onopaya too.
Atikram, the krama akrama.
In fact, there is no success, success you weigh of meditation or non-successive way of meditation.
Because non-successive way or successive way of meditation is done only what is to be meditated.
There is nothing to be meditated.
So, in that saatandrśakti, in the state of that saatandrśakti, you have not meditated anything.
So, it is neither successive nor non-successive.
It is neither shambua nor shaktar or anopaya.
Anopaya, yes, beyond that.
At the same time atikram, it excludes everything.
And it is arikta. Arikta means it includes everything.
This energy of saatandrśakti excludes everything.
excludes shambua, excludes shaktar and excludes anopaya.
All these three means are excluded there.
And at the same time, they are included there.
This is the state of saatandrśakti.
Why would they be excluded?
Because they don't have any effect, they don't have any reality in that.
There is no successive way, no not successive way.
There is neither successive way nor non-successive way.
So, that way they are excluded.
Because the way does not exist at all.
There is no way, there is no travelling.
They are excluded because everything is excluded.
Because from the point you start, that is to be saat.
That is to be held, not saat.
You have to hold it and that's all.
That ubi-atma-taya-p-abidi-man-api.
Although this saatandrśakti is both successful and non-successive.
Successive also.
Aneta-drupā.
It is beyond that, above that.
Because it is supreme.
Energy of Lord Shiva, which is absolutely independent awareness.
By which?
Yes.
Sabita-mahillā-sāt-prabhṛti-para-pramātri-vishrāntantam-śri-mātri-taya-dśyakti-chakra-svār-nātma-kṛda-yam-adarsita.
By which saatandrśakti, this whole play of creation, protection and destruction.
Creation of means is found in Anupāya.
Protection of means is found in Shakta-pāya.
Destruction of means is found in Shambha-pāya.
And this kind of play is played by saatandrśakti.
On which basis, in our own ground of Sarupa, Sabita-v, Mahillā-sāt-prabhṛti,
right from Pratvi up to Paramātri.
Mahillā-sāt-prabhṛti-para-pramātri-vishrāntantam, right from Pratvi to Paramātri-bhāva.
Tāśya-yedhādhābhā-śita-śya-śyakti-chakra-sya, and this Shakta-chakra.
And when the yogi who is hero, heroically, in a heroic way,
he meditates on that Shakta-chakra, on the collective class of energies of Shiva.
Collective class of energies is found only in one energy, saatandrśakti.
Otherwise they are separated, separatedly found.
Here in saatandrśakti, they are found in collective way.
Rāisya-amnāya-amnāti-nīdhā, this is explained in tantras which are rāisya,
which has secretly explained from master to disciples only.
These tantras were never published.
They were only taught by words, from master to disciples.
And the one yogi who contemplates on that Shakta-chakra, the totality of energies,
contemplating is called Yatavicita-Kramivyamarshanam.
Continuous contemplation on the wheel of energies by doing so,
Kalāgnyāja-charmakalānta-śya-śya-sya-samhāra.
From Kalāgnyāja-charmakalānta, right from Kalāgnyāja-charmakalānta-śya-tītakala.
This is the whole universe, and that dualistic universe consisting of,
right from Kalāgnyānta-charmakalānta-śya-tītakala is destroyed.
Destruction does not mean it is destroyed.
Although it is individually found, externally found, or found in your own awareness,
one feels that this whole universe has become one with parāsamhāra.
It has become one with the fire of Supreme Consciousness.
It is also said in Bhagashika-śastra.
Then, at the time of meditating on the wheel of energies,
Tadā, so Sarvam Kavali Kaurothi.
He digest everything in his own Supreme Being.
Murathum, he digest death, column, he digests in his self,
the sphere of time, Kalākalāpam, a band or bundle of all activities in the bound in the world.
They are also digested.
Vikāra-jālam, totality of all emotions, Pratipa-tesatmum,
becoming the object of all perceptions, Pratipa-tingans perceptions.
Because whenever you perceive things, you become one with that.
That is Pratipa-tesatmum.
Aikā-śminā-nā-nā-tni-vikal-pajātam, becoming the object of one thought or various thoughts.
Then, at that time, he digests and destroys everything.
Digest makes that whole enter in that Supreme consciousness of God.
Virav… Viravala-śastra also says the same thing.
Yatra-sarva-lāyam-yanti-dahyanti-etat-to-sanchaya, tam-chitim-pashikāyas-tham,
kāla-nālasamattisam, where everything is destroyed.
Everything gets entry and the whole totality of 36 elements are fired to ashes,
are burned to ashes.
That consciousness should be perceived in your own body,
which is just like kāla-gini, kāla-gini, shining like kāla-gini-rodra.
Malini-ji also says the same thing.
Uchāra-rāhitam-vas-thu, chaita-sāyva-vichintayan, yamsamāv-esamāv-noti-śākta-sotra-viri-yadi.
The one who is contemplating that, which cannot be uttered,
that which cannot be pronounced, unpronounced, and unuttered, being.
The one who meditates on that, unpronounced and unuttered, being.
And by doing so, the one who gets a trance, entry in his own nature,
that way of entry is called sākta-samāv-esamāv-esam.
Yatukta-etat-e-va-banga-nir-rodatam.
In Malini-vijya, it is also pointed.
He points out this state also there.
This kind of contemplating power will only appear before you by upāsana,
by upāsana, by serving the feet of your master.
So we would explain it more vividly now.
The more vivid explanation you must come from master's mouth.
Yatat-e-va-yadi-yadi-jaya-pratma-charmish-loka-bhyam-sangri-hitam.
This is narrated, narrated.
Narrated in Spanda by this first shloka and the last shloka.
Pratma means first shloka and charmish-loka-bhyam means last shloka.
Yes you should mention imeshāyam by whose twinkling, by whose unmeshā and imeshā.
This whole universe gets rise and destruction.
Yatukta-etat-e-kathr-sam-rhoda.
When one is sentenced to one pointiness, then he enters in his supreme consciousness.
Avam-next. Avam-upsam-rath-e-vijya-sya.
Narasamāv-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-kope.
So when the world of dualistic perception is completely destroyed or completely digested
in one's own consciousness, then difference between samadhi and vithana does not arise.
Narasamāv-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-yadi-kope.
